## Interested in doing a thesis here?

We take undergraduate, master's and doctoral students interested in quantitative
methods applied to ecology, conservation and urban systems. Some programming
background — R or Python — helps a great deal, though it is not an entry requirement.

If that sounds like you, write and tell us which of the lab's lines of work draws you
and what you would want to investigate. One specific paragraph says more than a CV.
